comment: Boundary probes for test-first behavior delivery versus diagnosis, refactoring, and test maintenance.

queries.query: Use $test-driven-development to add configurable retry limits, starting with a test that proves the behavior is missing.
Add case-insensitive username lookup. First create an automated check that fails for mixed-case input, then implement it.
We know blank usernames are accepted because validation trims too late. Capture that expected rejection in a failing regression test before fixing it.
The integration suite hangs intermittently in CI and nobody knows why. Diagnose the cause.
Split this parser into smaller modules without changing its CLI output, exit codes, or errors.
A payment test exposes a known rounding bug. Add the regression expectation before the fix, then extract the calculation helper without changing any other behavior.
